title: chrysanthemum inodorum
intro: Chrysanthemum inodorum, commonly known as She-Xiang or Chinese Chrysanthemum, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae) that has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries. It has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum inodorum include reducing inflammation, relieving fever, and soothing respiratory issues, making it a popular remedy for colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
